text: 7月20日，千衍基金公告称，基于对中国资本市场长期配置价值及旗下量化指增策略的坚定信心，公司及股东近期合计已申购旗下指数增强类产品超3000万元。后续将持续追加自有资金申购。
text_en: On July 20, Qianyuan Fund announced that based on confidence in China's capital market long-term allocation value and its quantitative index-enhancement strategy, the company and its shareholders have recently subscribed over 30 million yuan in its index-enhanced products, with plans to continue adding proprietary funds.
